rv.q: Somehow, though, the lines seem to exist independent of the character who speaks them.
But in this disappointing production, the pathos surfaces too late to make the wound a deep one.

tn.cat: Best Featured Actress in a Play

cn.t: Gray's acidic comedy retains its wit, but this revival proves uneven, with Lane's sharp delivery of zingers unable to fully capture the character's corrosive complexity in a production that doesn't quite match the play's bite.

vs.sum: The Booth Theatre offers good sightlines with a well-raked mezzanine and clear views from most seats, though legroom can be tight. The theater's elegant, European-inspired design adds to its charm, while sound quality is consistently praised. Facilities are average, with typical restroom and concession offerings.

acc.note: 6 wheelchair spaces in Orchestra. Not completely wheelchair accessible. Infrared devices available.
